title: THORChain Launches Native Zcash Swaps
summary: [PRESS RELEASE – George Town, , October 8, 2026 —, Cayman Islands, October 8th, 2026] THORChain, a decentralized exchange, announced that native Zcash (ZEC) swaps are now live, allowing users to exchange ZEC with assets across other supported blockchain networks without relying on wrapped tokens or a centralized exchange.
